tools.name: list_courses
tools.title: List Courses
tools.description: List courses for the authenticated user.

include_concluded.description: Include concluded/past enrollments in the results.

include_all.description: Include all enrollments instead of only current active ones.

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.title: Get Course Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific course.

tools.name: get_syllabus
tools.title: Get Syllabus
tools.description:
Get the complete Canvas Syllabus tab content for a course.

Unlike get_course_content_overview (which returns only a ~1000-char
preview), this returns the full syllabus body so later sections such as
grading policies, weighting, and final-exam details remain accessible.
The syllabus is complete by default; it is cut only if you pass
max_chars, and a cut is always marked with "[truncated at N characters]".

output_format.description:
"text" (plain text, default), "html" (raw HTML body),
or "both" (plain text followed by raw HTML)

max_chars.description:
Optional positive cap on the returned characters per
section. When exceeded, the content is truncated with an explicit
"[truncated...]" marker. Defaults to None (no truncation).

tools.name: get_course_content_overview
tools.title: Get Course Content Overview
tools.description: Get a comprehensive overview of course content including pages, modules, and syllabus.

include_modules.description: Include modules and their items (default: True)

tools.name: list_pages
tools.title: List Pages
tools.description: List pages for a specific course.

published.description: Filter by published status (None for all)

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.title: Get Page Content
tools.description:
Get the full content body of a specific page.

Returns the page's raw HTML body untruncated, followed by an inventory
of any embedded media (images, videos, iframes) with their source URLs,
so media is reported explicitly rather than left for the reader to spot
in the markup.

page_url_or_id.description: Page URL slug or page ID

tools.name: get_page_details
tools.title: Get Page Details
tools.description:
Get a specific page's metadata plus a short text preview.

Returns settings (status, timestamps, editor, editing roles) and a
PLAIN-TEXT preview capped at 500 characters. The preview drops all
markup, so embedded media is listed separately rather than silently
disappearing. For the full body, including media markup, use
get_page_content.

page_url_or_id.description: Page URL slug or page ID

tools.name: get_front_page
tools.title: Get Front Page
tools.description: Get the front page content for a course.

tools.name: list_module_items
tools.title: List Module Items
tools.description: List items within a specific module, including pages.

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.title: List Assignments
tools.description: List assignments for a specific course.

raw_dates.description:
Append a JSON block with each assignment's due_at,
unlock_at, lock_at, updated_at, all_dates and checkpoint dates
exactly as Canvas returns them (null stays null). Use it for
due-date audits: a checkpointed discussion has a null due_at
and its dates on the checkpoints. Default False.

tools.name: get_assignment_details
tools.title: Get Assignment Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific assignment.

raw_dates.description:
Append a JSON block with due_at, unlock_at, lock_at,
updated_at, all_dates and checkpoint dates exactly as Canvas
returns them (null stays null). Default False.

tools.name: list_discussion_topics
tools.title: List Discussion Topics
tools.description:
List discussion topics for a specific course.

Returns discussion topics only. Announcements are a separate Canvas
collection and are NOT included unless include_announcements=True.
To list announcements on their own, use list_announcements instead.

Without group_id this lists course-level topics only. Topics that
students start inside a group space are missing from that list; use
list_group_discussion_topics to find them across all groups.

include_announcements.description:
Also list the course's announcements
alongside its discussion topics (default: False). Each entry is
labelled "Type: Announcement" or "Type: Discussion".

group_id.description:
Canvas group ID, to read a discussion inside a group
space instead of the course (default: None). Discussions that
students start in a group exist only there. The group must
belong to the course.

tools.name: list_group_discussion_topics
tools.title: List Group Discussion Topics
tools.description:
List the discussion topics inside every group space of a course.

list_discussion_topics only sees course-level topics. Topics that
students start inside a group space exist only in that group, so use
this tool to find them. Each topic is marked either as a group copy of
a course topic or as started in the group itself. Read a topic's posts
with list_discussion_entries or get_discussion_with_replies, passing
the topic's group_id.

group_category_id.description:
Only include groups in this group set
(default: None, all groups in the course)

tools.name: list_announcements
tools.title: List Announcements
tools.description:
List a course's announcements, and nothing else.

Returns announcements only -- ordinary discussion topics are excluded.
Use list_discussion_topics for discussions.

tools.name: get_discussion_topic_details
tools.title: Get Discussion Topic Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific discussion topic.

group_id.description:
Canvas group ID, to read a discussion inside a group
space instead of the course (default: None). Discussions that
students start in a group exist only there. The group must
belong to the course.

raw_dates.description:
Append a JSON block with the topic's dates and, for a
graded discussion, its assignment's due_at, unlock_at, lock_at,
updated_at and checkpoint dates exactly as Canvas returns them
(null stays null). Default False.

tools.name: list_discussion_entries
tools.title: List Discussion Entries
tools.description: List discussion entries (posts) for a specific discussion topic with optional full content and replies.

include_full_content.description:
Return the complete text of every entry and
reply (default: False, which shows short previews)

include_replies.description: Fetch replies for each entry (default: False)

group_id.description:
Canvas group ID, to read a discussion inside a group
space instead of the course (default: None). Discussions that
students start in a group exist only there. The group must
belong to the course.

tools.name: get_discussion_entry_details
tools.title: Get Discussion Entry Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific discussion entry including all its replies.

group_id.description:
Canvas group ID, to read a discussion inside a group
space instead of the course (default: None). Discussions that
students start in a group exist only there. The group must
belong to the course.

tools.name: get_discussion_with_replies
tools.title: Get Discussion With Replies
tools.description:
Read every entry of a discussion in full, optionally with all replies.

Returns the topic title (not its body; get_discussion_topic_details has
that) and each top-level entry's author, post time, and complete text,
never cut; with include_replies=True each entry's replies are fetched
too, also complete. get_discussion_entry_details reads a single entry.

include_replies.description: Fetch detailed replies for all entries (default: False)

group_id.description:
Canvas group ID, to read a discussion inside a group
space instead of the course (default: None). Discussions that
students start in a group exist only there. The group must
belong to the course.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.title: List Modules
tools.description: List all modules in a course.

include_items.description: Include summary of items in each module

tools.name: get_course_structure
tools.title: Get Course Structure
tools.description: Get the full module and item structure for a course in a single call.

include_unpublished.description: Include unpublished modules and items (default: True)

tools.name: read_course_file
tools.title: Read Course File
tools.description:
Read a file from a Canvas course and return its content as base64.

Unlike download_course_file which saves to the server's local filesystem,
this tool returns the file content directly in the response. This is useful
when the MCP server runs on a different machine than the client.

Use list_course_files or list_module_items to find file IDs.

max_size_mb.description:
Maximum file size in MB to read (default: 25). Clamped server-side to
READ_FILE_MAX_SIZE_MB (default 100). Files larger than the effective limit are
rejected to avoid excessive memory usage.

tools.name: list_course_files
tools.title: List Course Files
tools.description: List files in a Canvas course with optional search.

sort.description: Sort field: name, size, created_at, updated_at, content_type (default: updated_at)

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.title: List Conversations
tools.description:
List conversations for the current user.

Returns one page of the inbox (Canvas's default page size). `returned`
is how many conversations are in this response; `more_available` is
true when Canvas reported further pages that were not fetched.

tools.name: get_conversation_details
tools.title: Get Conversation Details
tools.description:
Get detailed conversation information with messages.

Viewing never marks the conversation read; use mark_conversations_read
for that.

tools.name: get_unread_count
tools.title: Get Unread Count
tools.description: Get number of unread conversations.

tools.name: search_canvas_tools
tools.title: Search Canvas Tools
tools.description:
Search available Canvas tools by keyword — both the registered MCP
tools (e.g. list_peer_reviews, create_assignment) and the TypeScript
code-execution API used by execute_typescript().

query.description: Search term to filter tools (empty = all)

tools.name: get_my_enrollments
tools.title: Get My Enrollments
tools.description:
List the courses YOU are enrolled in, with your role in each.

Use this — not check_enrollment — for any question about your own
enrollment. check_enrollment reads the course roster, which requires
roster-admin rights your token probably does not have.

include_concluded.description:
Also include concluded/completed courses
(default False = active courses only).

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get My Profile
tools.description:
Get YOUR own Canvas identity (user ID, name, login ID).

Answers "who am I?" — useful when a tool needs your Canvas user ID or
NetID. Reports only your own record, never anybody else's.

tools.name: get_my_upcoming_assignments
tools.title: Get My Upcoming Assignments
tools.description: Get your upcoming assignments across all courses.

days.description: Number of days to look ahead (default: 7)

tools.name: get_my_submission_status
tools.title: Get My Submission Status
tools.description: Get your submission status for assignments.

course_identifier.description: Course code or Canvas ID (omit for all courses)

tools.name: get_my_course_grades
tools.title: Get My Course Grades
tools.description: Get your current grades across all enrolled courses.

tools.name: get_my_todo_items
tools.title: Get My Todo Items
tools.description: Get your Canvas TODO list.

tools.name: get_my_peer_reviews_todo
tools.title: Get My Peer Reviews Todo
tools.description: Get peer reviews YOU need to complete.

course_identifier.description:
Course code or Canvas ID (omit for all courses).
Required if assignment_identifier is given.

assignment_identifier.description:
Canvas assignment ID to check directly, bypassing
the per-course discovery scan. Use this when you already know which
assignment has your peer review — the discovery scan only queries
assignments whose "peer_reviews" flag came back true on the course's
assignment listing, so an assignment where that flag is missing or
stale for any reason would otherwise be silently skipped.

tools.name: list_my_announcements
tools.title: List My Announcements
tools.description:
List announcements across ALL your active courses in one call.

Cross-course: one query covers every course you are actively enrolled
in, newest first. For a single course's full announcement history use
list_announcements instead. Default window: the last 14 days.

course_identifier.description:
Optional course code or Canvas ID to show only
that course.

start_date.description:
Earliest post date, YYYY-MM-DD, MM/DD/YYYY or ISO
8601 (default: 14 days before end_date). A date-only value
starts at midnight in your Canvas account's time zone.

end_date.description:
Latest post date, same formats (default: now). A
date-only value includes that whole day in your Canvas
account's time zone; ISO timestamps are exact.

preview_chars.description:
Characters of body text to preview per
announcement (0-2000, default 400; 0 shows titles only). A
shortened preview says so; get_discussion_topic_details with
the course and announcement ID reads the whole announcement.

tools.name: get_my_activity_stream
tools.title: Get My Activity Stream
tools.description:
Your recent Canvas activity across all active courses, grouped by kind.

The dashboard "Recent Activity" feed: announcements, discussions,
inbox conversations, grades and submission comments, and
notifications, newest first. Reading it does not mark anything read.
Group activity and inbox messages not tied to a course are not
included (Canvas limits this feed to your active courses).

item_type.description:
Show only one kind: "announcements", "discussions",
"conversations", "submissions" (grades and submission
comments), "notifications", or "all" (default).

include_summary.description:
Also show per-kind total and unread counts
(default True).

preview_chars.description:
Characters of text to preview per item (0-2000,
default 300; 0 shows titles only).

tools.name: list_my_groups
tools.title: List My Groups
tools.description:
List the Canvas groups you belong to (project teams, study groups).

Shows each group's name, ID, course and course ID, group category ID
and member count. Use the group ID with get_group_members and
list_group_files.

To read a group's discussions or announcements, use the shared
discussion tools with the course ID and group ID printed here:
list_discussion_topics(course_identifier, group_id=...,
include_announcements=True) lists them, then
get_discussion_with_replies(course_identifier, topic_id,
include_replies=True, group_id=...) reads one with its replies.

course_identifier.description:
Only show your groups in this course
(course code or Canvas ID). Default: groups in every course.

tools.name: get_group_members
tools.title: Get Group Members
tools.description:
List the members of one of your groups (names and Canvas user IDs).

Only works for groups you belong to. Never shows email addresses. When
the server's data anonymization is on (ENABLE_DATA_ANONYMIZATION),
classmates' names appear as stable pseudonyms; IDs are real.

tools.name: list_group_files
tools.title: List Group Files
tools.description: List the files stored in one of your groups.

search_term.description: Only files whose name contains this text (2+ characters)

sort.description: name, size, created_at, updated_at or content_type (default: updated_at)

tools.name: get_my_assignment_scores
tools.title: Get My Assignment Scores
tools.description:
List your score on every assignment in a course, grouped by assignment group.

Shows each group's weight (when the course weights groups) and drop
rules, then each assignment's score / points possible and status:
graded, missing, late, excused, unsubmitted, submitted but ungraded,
pending review, grade not posted yet, or not counted toward the final
grade. Uses a student token's own submissions; it does not compute a
course total (use calculate_grade_scenarios for that).

tools.name: calculate_grade_scenarios
tools.title: Calculate Grade Scenarios
tools.description:
Recompute your course grade, try what-if scores, and find what you need on remaining work.

Reproduces Canvas's grade arithmetic (weighted or total-points groups,
drop lowest/highest and never-drop rules, excused and omitted
assignments, ungraded work excluded, groups with nothing graded left
out) and shows it next to Canvas's own current score, flagging any
disagreement. Optionally applies what-if scores, and reports the single
percentage you would need on every remaining ungraded assignment to
reach a target. Letters use the course's grading scheme when your token
can read it, else Canvas's default scheme; the output says which.
Nothing is changed in Canvas.

hypothetical_scores.description:
Optional what-if points by assignment ID, e.g.
{"12345": 18, "12346": 9.5}. Points, not percentages.

target_letter.description:
Optional target letter, e.g. "A-" (from the scheme in
use). Give target_percent or target_letter, not both.

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.title: List Quizzes
tools.description:
List the quizzes in one of YOUR courses: Classic and New Quizzes.

Read-only. Shows due/open/close dates, time limit, allowed attempts,
points and your submission state. It never opens a quiz, starts an
attempt, or reads questions or answers.

Classic quizzes are listed by quiz ID; New Quizzes by assignment ID
(Canvas exposes them only as assignments). Use get_quiz_details for one
quiz and your attempts.

tools.name: get_quiz_details
tools.title: Get Quiz Details
tools.description:
Get one quiz's settings and YOUR OWN latest attempt (used, remaining, kept score).

Read-only. It never starts an attempt and never reads questions or
answers. Pass exactly one of quiz_id (a Classic quiz, as listed by
list_quizzes) or assignment_id (a New Quiz, or the assignment of a
graded Classic quiz). For New Quizzes Canvas does not expose settings
or attempt history to students, and the result says so. With grading
rights in the course, attempts are not requested at all.

tools.name: get_my_submission
tools.title: Get My Submission
tools.description: Get your own submission for an assignment, including attempts used.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.title: List Calendar Events
tools.description:
List your Canvas calendar: course events, personal events, group
events and assignment due dates, in date order.

Covers every active course, your personal calendar and your groups
unless course_identifier narrows it. For submission status of upcoming
assignments use get_my_upcoming_assignments instead.

start_date.description:
Window start, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 with an offset
(default: today)

end_date.description:
Window end, inclusive (default: start + days); the
window may span at most 366 days

days.description: Look-ahead when end_date is omitted (default 14, max 366)

course_identifier.description: Only this course's calendar (code or Canvas ID)

tools.name: get_calendar_event
tools.title: Get Calendar Event
tools.description: Get one calendar event in full, including its description.

event_id.description:
Numeric calendar event ID (from list_calendar_events). For
an assignment due date, use get_assignment_details instead.

tools.name: list_planner_notes
tools.title: List Planner Notes
tools.description: List your own planner notes (personal to-do items) in a date window.

start_date.description:
Window start, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601 with an offset
(default: today)

end_date.description:
Window end, inclusive (default: start + days); the
window may span at most 366 days

days.description: Look-ahead when end_date is omitted (default 14, max 366)

course_identifier.description: Only notes linked to this course

tools.name: find_message_recipients
tools.title: Find Message Recipients
tools.description:
Find people you can message in a course, with their Canvas user IDs.

Use it to look up your instructor's or TA's user ID before
send_message. Only individual people are returned. While data
anonymization is on, people who are not course staff are listed
under a Student_<hash> pseudonym, and a name search returns course
staff only.

search.description:
Part of a name to match, e.g. "smith" (omit to list all).
While anonymization is on, matches only course staff.

tools.name: list_courses
tools.description: List active Canvas courses available to the authenticated account.

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Get basic details for one Canvas course by course ID.

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description: List assignments and due dates for one Canvas course.

tools.name: create_assignment
tools.description: Create an unpublished assignment with a timezone-qualified due date.

tools.name: update_assignment
tools.description: Update only the provided name, due date, description, or points for an assignment.
